title: Crash occurs when applying binlog_transaction_dependency_tracking to slave node.
review_reason: Concurrent sysbench workload and changing GLOBAL binlog dependency tracking are essential; later c551404 gives 500 threads/60,000 seconds and enabled binary logging. This exceeds current PID/time/concurrency limits and ordinary --skip-log-bin runner. Need bounded approved multi-client reproduction protocol with full binlog settings.
